d: The Pentagon is still struggling to track millions of F-35 spare parts worth billions of dollars years after government watchdogs first exposed problems with its tracking system, a new report states. The Government Accountability Office said that while the DoD’s F-35 program “is the costliest in its history,” the department “struggles to account” for its parts. The Pentagon has spent over US$31 billion on buying roughly 26 million F-35 spare parts to support the global fleet of the stealth fighters; however, it has kept poor records and failed to accurately keep track of those parts and…
